_comment: One definition per term. The gate fails if a document uses a listed variant. Add a term here before using it in a paper.

terms.note: CycloneDX standardisation. ISO/IEC 5962 is SPDX and must never be attached to CycloneDX.
Overview and fundamental principles. Part number is mandatory at every use.

bare_forms_forbidden.message: ISO 15926 must carry a part number. Parts differ: 1 overview, 2 data model, 4 reference data library. Naming the whole standard as the "ISO 15926 series" is the only unqualified form allowed, plus the exceptions listed here.

exceptions.reason: references/WG-05-CAD-DEXPI-2/WG-05-CAD-DEXPI-Open-Standard-Position-Paper.md lines 5, 27, 29 and 168. Each of those four sentences means the multi-part standard as a whole, not one part: line 5 pairs the series with the ISO 15926-4 reference data library in the same sentence, line 27 heads a section covering both the information model and the reference data library, line 29 cites the series title common to every part, and line 168 again pairs series with part 4. "Series" states the referent explicitly, so no part number is missing. Assigning a part here would make the citation wrong, not more precise.

references/WG-05-CAD-DEXPI-2/WG-05-CAD-DEXPI-Open-Standard-Position-Paper.md line 19. The phrase sits inside an attributed pull quote from a mechanical engineer. The speaker did not state a part. Editing quoted speech to satisfy a lint rule falsifies the quotation, which is a worse fault than an imprecise citation, so the quote stands and the exception is recorded here instead. The carve-out is pinned to this exact wording: a bare "ISO 15926" anywhere else, including "ISO 15926 / Proteus XML" without the "DEXPI 2.0 (" prefix, still fails.

bare_forms_forbidden.message: "Track N //" labelled four homepage section counters and a three-button subject picker as research tracks. Research Track names the section and the route; a numbered counter is not one. Use Portal 0N // for section counters, or no prefix at all.
Eigenia's unit is a Working Group. "Workstream" appears in the corpus only for ENTSO-E's, each with an explicit non-affiliation note, and must not be adopted for Eigenia's own output.
